notes.title: KAUNA development update #1
notes.content: [p]Hello! [/p][p]Development of [b]KAUNA[/b] is progressing well, and I’d like to share some highlights from the past few months.[/p][p]This is the first devlog‑type post, and I hope it gives you insight into how KAUNA evolves.[/p][p][b]A big thanks to everyone who has wishlisted the game[/b]—your support means the world to me![/p][p][/p][p]That said, here are some of the features I want to share:[/p][p][/p][h3]Car[/h3][p][/p][p]The game will feature a fully drivable car and driving levels where you can run over hordes of enemies. You get a short ride at the beginning of the game. Later, the car is stolen by demons, and your mission is to retrieve it while fighting your way through the Underworld.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45544748/0a179872bde8f9e5cd3c60b2ae5733c43ff72755.png"][/img][/p][h3]Keybindings menu[/h3][p][/p][p]I spent a lot of time getting the key‑bindings menu to work, and it was definitely worth it. It makes the game much more accessible.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45544748/b978c63cf75748d9f8559bf45a9d6a317cba33f1.png"][/img][/p][h3]Custom skyboxes and more detailed levels[/h3][p][/p][p]I've added several new custom skyboxes and increased level detail to give the world a more polished feel.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45544748/f95077f2137ae4ce6749ad73b3c2e77a1ae49d56.png"][/img][/p][h3]New enemy: Tuonela Acolyte[/h3][p][/p][p]A new melee enemy that also has ranged‑spell‑casting and archer variants. These zombie‑like cultists appear later in the game.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45544748/eba1e84ea79333d7b538d197b252be2c9f37782e.png"][/img][/p][h3]What next?[/h3][p][/p][p]My next big milestone is to release [b]a demo[/b] on Steam. That will involve polishing mechanics and levels, as well as completing several unfinished areas over the coming months. [/p][p][/p][p]A new trailer is also in progress, so you can expect it to drop sometime soon![/p][p][/p][p]-Antti[/p]
